title: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

sense.text: “Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.” To rebuke is to correct. The question the verse puts to us is who is your brother, and who is your neighbour.

The next verse answers it: “Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.” The children of thy people is your race. Love your neighbour as you love yourself, the way Christ meant it, is love your race as you love yourself.

So where is the weeping, the moaning, the crying for our own people? Black Christians wept and wailed over Charlie Kirk, a man who did not hide how much he could not stand black people, a man who said Martin Luther King was not worthy of a national holiday and the civil rights movement was a mistake. They never cried like that for Martin Luther King, Malcolm X, Marcus Garvey, Patrice Lumumba, Thomas Sankara, Sandra Bland, Breonna Taylor, George Floyd, Philando Castile or Ahmaud Arbery, nor for the black people killed every day. Those black Christians despise love your neighbour as yourself, and they would put us to death if given the chance.

Christianity does not teach this law. It teaches love the same man who oppressed you, love Europeans first. It has been teaching us wrong for centuries.

precepts.why:
Asked “which is the great commandment in the law?”, Christ answers, “Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment.” Christ was quoting Moses; better said, Moses was quoting Christ.

The ten commandments line up with it. The first four deal with loving the Most High with all your heart, mind and soul: no other gods before him, not taking his name in vain, no idols nor images, and remembering the sabbath day to keep it holy. The rest, from the fifth down, deal with the second: “And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.”

Love thy neighbour is love your race, love the children of thy people. It is the same thing Leviticus 19:18 says, and that is why our weeping belongs first to our own people.

sense.text:
“The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?” Christians say hear my heart, feel my heart, follow your heart. God never tells us to follow our heart; that is what Europeans taught us to do. The heart is wicked, and when the scripture says your heart, it means your mind.

We must always go by what the word of God says, not by what we feel. That is what blacks and Latinos have not done.

precepts.why:
Christ shows that the heart is the mind: “For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts”. Evil thoughts come from your mind. And with them “adulteries, fornications, murders, Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.”

So Christ never instructed us to follow our heart. Feel my heart, listen to my heart: no. Your heart is wicked, and only the word of God can be followed.

sense.text:
“Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.” Our whole duty is to keep God’s commandments. Love God with all your heart, mind and soul; love your neighbour as yourself, which is your people; and keep his commandments.

We have no thought for that man. Our focus is to be God and our people, not this system with its two-pronged government of Republicans and Democrats, and the people who insert themselves into it by bribery.

“The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence”. Christian commentaries say this was Assyria coming to destroy Egypt, but notice the wording: the Lord himself rides upon a swift cloud and the idols are moved at his presence. That could not be the Assyrians, and it is not Sennacherib. It is the return of Christ into the spiritual Egypt, which is Babylon, which is America.

“And the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it”, because he is coming with fire.

“And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.” That is white folks against white folks: civil war. Republicans against Democrats. You thought it could never happen here, and you saw a little of it on January 6. They even put out a movie called Civil War, where a white man with a gun asks another white man, I know you are American, but what kind of American are you?

“And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof”. The counsel they have, trying to keep things together, is going to fail; the spirit here is going to fail. “And they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards”: that is Hollywood.

“And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts.” The commentaries say this was Nebuchadnezzar, or Sennacherib. It is for this time now, and it is not just one man. Although it says king, it is a system that is set up.

A president gets two terms, eight years, and then he is gone. He is a manager, a spokesperson. One man cannot run a country with some 850 military bases in other countries; there are people behind the scenes who control the government. That is what the former CIA agent called the deep state and the shadow government: the Rothschilds, the Vatican with the black pope and the white pope, the Chabad Jews, with the Freemasons and the Knights of Malta as their fixers and the world banks as their managers. The politicians, military leaders and bankers are only the best of the servant class.

The deep state is within the state, the unelected career officials, intelligence officers and military leaders who rarely change while presidents come and go. The shadow government stands outside the state, like the Vatican and the Rothschilds. Together they are the fierce king, the cruel lord.

precepts.why:
What Egypt is Isaiah speaking of? “And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.”

Revelation 11 is talking about Babylon, and it lets us know that Babylon, which is America, is spiritually called Sodom, because of homosexuality, and Egypt. This place here is a spiritual Egypt. Christians cannot see that; they believe if it says Egypt it means Egypt and that is it.

Zophar asks that God “would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is!” We all want God’s secrets of wisdom, and here is one: many of these prophetic scriptures have double meanings.

In ancient times Assyria did invade Egypt. But Isaiah 19 is also speaking of the spiritual Egypt, which is Babylon, America, in these last days.

Here is another Egypt: “And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships”. The word to highlight is again. The twelve tribes were in Egypt only one time, and we walked into Egypt. Now Moses says we would go into Egypt again, with ships.

The word Egypt means house of bondage, house of oppression, house of captivity, house of slavery. What slavery did we go into with ships? The transatlantic slave trade. Christians refuse to see it, because if that is true then we are the Israelites, and they refuse to go against the white man who says he is the biblical Jew. So they would rather stay negroes and coons.

“Thou shalt see it no more again”: we would not see that old Egypt again. “And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen”: slave men and slave women, sold once we got off those ships.

“And no man shall buy you.” Many great black leaders rose up to free us and were assassinated: Nat Turner, Denmark Vesey, Gabriel Prosser, Chris Hani in South Africa, Martin Luther King, Medgar Evers, Marcus Garvey, Fred Hampton and the Black Panther Party. Assata Shakur fled to Cuba with a million-dollar bounty on her head; the rest were killed. No man could redeem us.

There is only one saving: “Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people”. He is not the God of all races; he is the Lord God of Israel. He “hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David”: that is Christ, from the lineage of David, “As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began”.

The purpose of Christ’s coming, his death, his resurrection and his return is “That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us”. He is the only one who can save us from our enemies.

We always look for a man on earth to do it. No: deliverance is not coming laterally; it is coming from up on high, from God Almighty. That is the Lord riding upon the swift cloud into Egypt in Isaiah 19:1: Christ’s return into the spiritual Egypt.

“The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.” We see things happen in the past and think they were only for back then. You thought it was just the North and the South back then; the Egyptians will be set against the Egyptians again.

When Trump said Make America Great Again, the question was put: what era in American history was America ever great for black people? The 1600s, the 1700s, the 1800s, the 1900s? There was no answer. Making America great again is detrimental for black and brown people, because America has never been great for black and brown people.

sense.text: Nebuchadnezzar dreamed of a great statue: a head of gold, arms of silver, a waist of brass, legs of iron, and feet of iron and clay. “Thou art this head of gold”: Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonian empire were the head of gold.

“And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee”: the second kingdom, the silver, was Persia and Media, ruling from 539 to 331. “And another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth”: the Greeks, under Alexander.
“And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron”: that is Rome. Rome conquered everybody; it broke in pieces and subdued all things.

“And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes”: the feet and toes are America, the EU and NATO. We are in that kingdom now, the last kingdom of the prophecy. “The kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron”: that strength is their military. “So the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.”

“They shall mingle themselves with the seed of men”: the seed of men is all the various nations, countries, races and nationalities here. “But they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.” Can somebody tell the black Christian: prophecy says blacks and whites cannot cleave together. We did not write it, and we cannot undo it.

While you are busy singing Ebony and Ivory, remember Michael Jackson and Paul McCartney became enemies when Michael bought the Beatles’ publishing rights. White people still talk down on black people, and black Christians love them so much.

“And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom”. We are here now. A kingdom is a government, “which shall never be destroyed”. If they did to us what they did to MOVE in Philadelphia in 1985, dropping a bomb and killing men, women and children while the black church stayed silent, as long as there is one man or one woman, it will not stop. The teaching is in our spirit and our soul, and it will start all over again.

“And the kingdom shall not be left to other people”. White men are not going to rule, the Chinese are not going to rule, the Arabs are not going to rule. Christ and the 144 are the kingdom, and under them the great multitude of Israelites out of all nations, kingdoms and tongues. They sent us as slaves to Brazil, so we speak Portuguese; to Spain, so we speak Spanish; to Madagascar, Sri Lanka, Mauritania, India, Pakistan, Iran and Iraq. We are the only people on earth who are found scattered in every country, because of the Bible.

“But it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.”

precepts.why:
“Come out of her, my people”. We are God’s people, and the voice says come out of Babylon, “that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues”, the judgment that is coming.

That is why iron does not mix with clay. Of course you have to go to work and school, where all nations come together. But when you go home, do you have to bring them home to marry your sister? Hell no. They sure as hell don’t take you to their home, but you are always taking them to yours. They don’t bring it to the white churches, but black people are always trying to bring massa into the black church. Come out of her.

If God is setting up a kingdom in the days of these kings, why don’t we see it? Read from verse 16: “But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?” What wicked is ruling the earth and taking God’s covenant in its mouth? One group takes the old covenant as Jewish; another takes the new covenant as Christians.

“Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.” The white man swears you in on the Bible in court, then puts the Bible away and judges you by a penal code. They cast the word of God behind them.

“When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him”: to consent is to agree. Israel is blowing up Palestine, calling themselves settlers, and America says nothing and gives them the weapons, because America were settlers too. Settler is a nice word for thieves. They robbed, stole, murdered and took land in America, in South Africa where they set up apartheid, and in Australia, where they murdered millions of black people. “And hast been partaker with adulterers”: when they raped, robbed and pillaged, they raped the women as well, as they do over there today.

“Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit”: God gave us this land, manifest destiny, you made us do this to you. “Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son”: Jacob is the brother, slandered day in and day out.

“These things hast thou done, and I kept silence”: God stayed silent. “Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself”: because God was not judging them, they said surely God is a white man, painted white images throughout the earth and forced us to worship them. “But I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.” That is the kingdom being set up now: God setting us in order, the men and the women, the whole nation, in every congregation. God is about government; he is about order.

“For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder”. God is establishing his government. When these classes teach God’s laws, his testimonies and his prophecies and set men in order, it is about government, and it is not going to stop.

“Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace” are all titles for Christ. “Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever.”

“The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.” This word was not given to everybody. That is the kingdom of Daniel 2:44 that shall never be destroyed: there shall be no end.

“But it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms.” Here is the New Testament precept: “And he that overcometh”, his own sins, “and keepeth my works”, the commandments, which are the works of Christ, “unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers”.

Broken to shivers is what Daniel 2 said: the kingdom breaks these kingdoms in pieces. When the Lord sets up his government we are not going to the kingdoms of the world saying, will you please do what God said. It is obey God’s commandments or die. That is what breaking in pieces means. We are going to break all nations in pieces and force them to obey God’s commandments. Get mad if you want; that is what the Bible says.

sense.text:
Having spoken of God’s government, now the wicked government. Paul was talking about Rome being in connection with Satan. “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood”: that is why Paul and the apostles were not trying to fight Rome, and why Christ said his kingdom was not of this world, or his followers would fight. It was not the time, and it is not the time now. You crazy brothers out there, don’t be doing nothing.

“But against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” We do not wrestle against flesh and blood because spirits inhabit seats. Black people voted for Barack Obama because he was black, and black women called him our Moses. He sat in that seat and a spirit came on him, and he said he was not doing anything just for black people. Kamala Harris said the same. They will do things for white people and for the Chinese, but not for black people. That is the spirit in the seat, whether president, vice president, the cabinet or the House of Representatives. Fauci retired, someone else sits there now, and the spirit has come on that person.

No matter how much you fight a person physically, once he is moved out of the way and somebody else takes the seat, the spirit comes on that one. Spirits worked with Babylon, Persia and Media, Greece and Rome, and with the feet and toes now. The only way to overcome is through God’s word, not through guns; the Black Panthers showed that, and they changed the gun laws for black people because of it.

That hidden power is a cryptocracy: a secretive government where the true leaders and the source of power are concealed, the official leaders a facade, and private groups operate behind the scenes. That is the deep state and the shadow government.

precepts.why:
“And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion”. In Daniel 7 the leopard was the Greeks, the bear the Persian empire, and the lion Babylon. So this new kingdom, America, has elements of ancient Greece, Persia and Media, and Babylon in it. That is why many prophecies of Persia, Greece and Babylon are not only about the ancient kingdoms but about America; you have to read precept upon precept.

“And the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.” Satan gave them their seat of authority. Some of our people say, I want to make an allegiance with this beast, I want a seat of authority with this beast, so I can help black people. You may have good intentions, but once you sit in that seat a spirit comes on you and you are never the same again. It never happens.

You read the word beast and think it is an animal. “I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.”

The sons of men are beasts. When Daniel 7 speaks of four beasts and Revelation 13 speaks of the beast, it is talking about men on earth: kingdoms and the men who rule them.

Here is an example of a seat. The Pharisees descended from the Maccabean era, the Assideans, whose forefathers were great warriors against Greece; by the time Rome came to power, Maccabees records Israelites paying for their seats as high priests.

“Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.” Their place was their seat as leaders of Israel, given to them by Rome.

Just as Rome gave them their seats, today America, new Rome, gives seats to the Black Caucus, the bourgeoisie and the Boule, and to black religious leaders, who are even more influential in the black community. When they get those seats, a spirit comes on them. Karen Bass spoke up for us while she was in Congress; now she is a mayor, and she is silent.

sense.text: Our people who sit with the powers that be have given their soul and their allegiance to them. They can repent, but the chances are slim; don’t trust them. Here is our allegiance with other races against our own people: “Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying, Let us go up against Judah, and vex it”. Ephraim was one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and Ephraim joined with Syria to go against the kingdom of Judah, to “set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal”.
“Thus saith the Lord God, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.” God was against the northern kingdom for daring to join with another race against their brothers.

This continues from Isaiah 7. “Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces”: he is speaking to the northern kingdom, who associated with Syria. Our people today do the same thing: I want to join with the liberals, with the Democrats, with the Republicans, against my people. “Gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.”

“Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought”, just as Syria and Ephraim took counsel together. God is saying to us: you take counsel with the Republicans, with the Democrats, with the liberals, and it shall not stand. “For God is with us”: that is what Judah said to Ephraim.
“Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy”. The confederacy was Ephraim and Syria. “Neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.”

“Sanctify the Lord of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.” Isaiah told the northern kingdom to sanctify the Lord of hosts, and he tells us the same today. Don’t fear America; fear God.

“But for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel”: the northern kingdom and the southern kingdom. “And many among them shall stumble”. Many of our people stumble at Christ. Some stumble at his ethnicity and say Jesus was a white man; some stumble at his teaching and say he did not teach the commandments.

“Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” That is what Christ, the King of kings and Lord of lords, taught. You stumble because you don’t want to do it.

Marriage is one example. Christ honoured marriage, and through Paul he called it honourable. Yet some men and women say to hell with marriage, I can do bad all by myself, get a friend with benefits; some little Israelite camps and some Christians teach get five women on the side. They are stumbling at Christ, and that is just one law they stumble at.

“And I will wait upon the Lord, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.” This verse is important for us today. We pray and pray, and it seems the Lord is not answering when we want him to. We want deliverance right now, but there are prophecies that must come to pass before Christ returns, and he cannot change his word. Tobit was blind eight years before his eyes were healed; Joseph waited years in prison. Deliverance came, but not immediately. He has revealed that we are the Israelites, but he is hiding his face, and we must wait upon him.
“Behold, I and the children whom the Lord hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel”: Christ and the apostles, his disciples, were for signs and wonders in Israel.

“Seek unto them that have familiar spirits”: people say don’t follow that black Jesus thing, it is a cult; go to sister so-and-so who tells your fortune and what your dead grandmama said. Go to Hollywood: every witch has a piece of wood to cast spells with, like in Harry Potter, and holly wood casts spells on the people who sit and watch.

A woman once argued with her man because his Christmas gift was not what Luke gave Laura on General Hospital. People get mesmerized by what they see on TV, TikTok and social media, bring it home, make it an idol, and destroy themselves, their relationships and their kids.

“And unto wizards that peep, and that mutter”: watch out for people who mutter; that is spirits. “Should not a people seek unto their God?” Open the Bible, read, and pray unto the Lord. “For the living to the dead?”

“To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.” If they speak not according to the laws and testimonies of God, they are the devil the Bible speaks of. Men, women, Hollywood and social media are not giving you God’s law or his testimony; they are giving you feel my heart, hear my heart, and it is all deceit.

The first alliance is marriage. “Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you”.

“Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes”.

On the news you see black athletes marry Europeans; a few years later they divorce, the European takes the money home to her daddy and mommy, and the negro sits on the side broke, crying. Everybody can see the train coming for young Travis Hunter; we have to pray for the brother. God said don’t make marriages with them, but y’all know better than God. Some of you are the products of interracial marriage, and we have love for you, but that is what the Bible says.

The second alliance is religious. “Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard”: adversaries means enemies. Up to the 1960s and 70s we always knew who our enemies were. Today ask black people or Latinos who their enemy is and they say none, as though everyone who spat on us as children changed when they became judges, police officers, firemen and congressmen.

They came to Zerubbabel and said, “Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do”. The other nations wanted to join with Zerubbabel and Jeshua to rebuild the temple: we believe in the same God you do, and we have sacrificed to him “since the days of Esar–haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither”, going back to 2 Kings 17.

“Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the Lord God of Israel”. Say that today and they call you racist.

That is the answer to the Abrahamic Family House in Abu Dhabi: a mosque, a synagogue and a church in one complex, built to unify the faiths, inspired by a document signed by Pope Francis and the Grand Imam. They want a unified interfaith religion, a one world order, and Donald Trump went there and signed his name to it, while sending bombs to kill their brothers in Gaza.

The third alliance is political. “And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly”. The northern kingdom had gone into idolatry, and they went into business together, “to make ships to go to Tarshish”. One served God Almighty and the other served a rock.

“Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the Lord hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.” God intervened and broke their ships. You can’t worship God and join with the wicked.

precepts.why:
Why did God break the ships? A few chapters before, when Jehoshaphat returned to Jerusalem, Jehu the seer met him and said, “Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the Lord? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the Lord.”

That is why bad things happen to some of you: you join with those who hate God Almighty, a friend or a family member you just love, though you know they hate God.

Our people like to sit in Congress and do the bidding of America, and in those meetings against our own people there is always a black man or woman sitting there who is not for their own people. A black politician said he was not paid by Israel, and they pulled the receipts: $25,000. Don’t trust these black politicians. The white ones lie too, but we lower our guard with the black ones, and they will be the first to lie in our face and stab us in the back.

sense.text: What Israel gives out are bribes, and God calls it bribery. “All bribery and injustice shall be blotted out: but true dealing shall endure for ever.” When you become a politician or a religious leader, countries like Israel bribe you so that you cannot speak against Israel or against white supremacy, and you condemn the Israelites. Pastor Philip Anthony Mitchell went to Israel, allegedly got paid big money, and after the trip his whole message became speaking against the Israelites.

precepts.why: “In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.” That is the politician and the religious leader paid so they will not speak against Israel or against white supremacy.
“For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.” The bribery that Ecclesiasticus says shall be blotted out, fire shall consume.

“For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.”

That is what black politicians and black religious leaders do. They take bribes, and then they hear no evil, see no evil, speak no evil. They will never speak against injustice, because they got paid.

sense.text: The fourth alliance is social, tying back to marriage. “And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.”

“And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods. And Israel joined himself unto Baal–peor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.” We dealt with the women of other nations and worshipped their gods, and the Lord got mad with us.

precepts.why:
The story was not over. After the war Moses said, “Have ye saved all the women alive? Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.”

Balaam was hired to curse Israel and could not. So he counselled: bring the women of the other races to manipulate the simps among Israel, get them to worship their gods, and then their own God would be against them. It was orgies, sex and worship. Some of you sitting here have been manipulated the same way.

“Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.” God wanted them all dead. Christians say they can’t wait for God to come back; are you reading the same book? Examine yourself and fix yourself before you say that.

sense.text: The fifth alliance is cultural: aligning our culture to other people’s culture. “Not setting by the honours of their fathers”: our people did not set by the honours of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, “but liking the glory of the Grecians best of all.” We liked the glory and fame of the Greeks best of all: Greek culture, Greek society, Greek women, Greek religion and Greek dress.

“By reason whereof sore calamity came upon them: for they had them to be their enemies and avengers”. The Greeks were our enemies, yet we wanted them to avenge us and went to them for help. “Whose custom they followed so earnestly, and unto whom they desired to be like in all things.”

We do the same today: we desire to be like the white supremacist in all things. That is why we blonde our hair, perm our hair and lighten our skin; if you black, get back, if you light, you all right. In college we join Greek fraternities and sororities, at HBCUs founded by white Jewish people, fake Jews. Then those people go into politics and religion and become enemies of their own race, nine out of ten of them.

God warns us all through the Bible not to make an alliance with his enemies: come out from among them, separate yourself. “In those days went there out of Israel wicked men, who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us”: let us make an agreement with the Greeks. Today it is let us be Republicans, Democrats, conservatives, liberals.

“For since we departed from them we have had much sorrow.” They said things went bad for us when we separated from the Greeks. The same thing is said today: join this party, join that religion.

precepts.why:
Christ spoke through Paul and said the same thing in the New Testament: “Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers”. Some of you find somebody in the world who floats your boat; you know they don’t believe like you, but you think you can make it work, and it always ends badly.

As a society we try to join with Christians and with Muslims, knowing they don’t believe like we believe and nobody keeps any commandments. That is an ungodly alliance. “For what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness? And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?” An infidel is an unbeliever.

“And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God”. Why are you joined with this man or this woman who are idolaters? “Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you”.

We don’t believe like Christians. They worship a figment of their imagination that does not exist in the Bible, the image the oppressors forced on our ancestors. We believe the true Bible and the true God.

sense.text: Still the ungodly alliance. “Wherefore hear the word of the Lord, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.” Those who rule are the political leaders and the religious leaders together.

“Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement”. Death is the white man and what he comes with, and they make an agreement with him. Hell is the low, oppressed condition our people stay in. Whatever political leader comes, they promise us the world and we get nothing; the one black leader gets his seat, a million dollars and health care for his family the rest of his life, like Maxine Waters, but our condition as a whole remains the same. Keep them like that, just make sure I’m good.

“When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us”: black political and religious leaders think nothing will happen to them when judgment comes, because they are protected by the white man’s lies. “For we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves”.

“And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand”. “From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you”: from the time the brothers prophesy that it is going to happen, it shall take them. “And it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.” The report is the scriptures being prophesied, and it is a vexation to them.

“For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it”. That bed is the lies of verse 15. Imagine trying to get comfort, six feet tall, on a three-foot bed. “And the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it”: a one-foot blanket. They have heard the report and the understanding of the scriptures, these black politicians and black religious leaders; they try to find comfort in their lies and their agreement with the white man, but there is no comfort there, because they know the prophecies will come to pass.

precepts.why:
Here is that alliance in the time of Christ: “And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.”

The Herodians were a political group, supporters of the Herodian dynasty and the Roman-backed tetrarchs like Herod Antipas: black political leaders. They joined with the Pharisees, black religious leaders, to destroy Christ. A religious group and a political group came together against Christ. As it was back then, so it shall be today.

sense.text: Nahum prophesied during the Assyrian captivity, the time of Jonah and Tobit. “The burden of Nineveh.” Nineveh was the capital of Assyria, the wicked kingdom. Christianity has never taught you to associate Nineveh with America; you have been taught they are two separate things. They are one and the same.

“Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” Assyria was the wellfavoured harlot.

precepts.why:
“And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” Nahum called Nineveh the wellfavoured harlot, and Revelation calls Babylon the mother of harlots. They have the same attributes.

“And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.” John was shocked at what this harlot, this Babylonian system, did.

Christianity says don’t read the Old Testament, start with Matthew, so you never correlate the two and never get the proper understanding of what is happening.

sense.text: “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.” How does he know us that trust in him? He puts us through trials, and a trial proves whether you trust in the Lord. Everybody says I love my neighbour as myself. Then the Lord allows Satan to stir up a brother or sister next to you to get on your nerves, and when it comes time to apply it you give them the finger or start a fist fight. You just failed. People say they won’t come to a congregation because they might not get along with everybody; that means God needs to purge and cleanse you.
“But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.” He is going to make an overrunning flood here in this place.
“What do ye imagine against the Lord? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.” Once the Lord takes this place down, it will not rise again.

“And while they are drunken as drunkards”. Our people are drunk with philosophies, religious ideologies and political groups. Years ago black people were Democrat, Democrat, Democrat; now it is Republican, Republican, Republican.
“There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the Lord, a wicked counsellor.” One out of Nineveh. Don’t look for just one man; it is a system of people.

“Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through.” Many Europeans, cut down. “Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.” God allowed us to go into slavery, and he promises to afflict us no more.

“For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.” The yokes of iron today are not on our necks but on our minds, spirits and souls: Christianity, politics, Baptists, Lutherans, Mormons, concupiscence, lasciviousness and adultery, lie after lie. We are mesmerized, lied to and manipulated by social media. God said he will break those yokes off us.

“And the Lord hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown”. The thee is Esau, Edom. Today you pay thousands for Gucci, Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Versace and Prada, old family names from the Renaissance; China makes those bags and shoes for three dollars and you buy them for three thousand, keeping their name sown in the earth.

“Out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image”: that is the Vatican. God has promised to destroy the house of their gods and all their graven images. “I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.”

“Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace!” The good tidings are the brothers going out teaching. “O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.” Why does he name Judah? Because Judah is raised up first.

precepts.why:
“Affliction shall not rise up the second time.” What does that mean? “Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her”.

When Trump says Make America Great Again: once the Lord takes this place down, it is not going to resurrect itself. It is over and finished. That is not going to happen.

The wicked counsellor is not just one man; it is a system of people. “I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn”. The horns on the beast represent NATO and the European Union, and the little horn that came up among them is America, “before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots”: Spain in the Spanish-American War, Britain in the war of independence, and France.

Jump to verse 20: “And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.” America’s look is more stout: greater in power than Spain, France, Britain, Germany and Russia.

“And in the latter time of their kingdom”, the feet and toes of Daniel 2, “when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.” Although it says king, it is not one person; it is a leadership, a shadow government, a group of people behind the scenes who run everything. Trump is just a figurehead.

“And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”: the dragon gave him his power, as Revelation 13:2 said. “And shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” We have been destroyed as a race and a people, scattered from country to country, our power gone.

“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”: his policy is his politics, political and religious. “And by peace shall destroy many”: they invited Iran to peace talks in Geneva, and while the ambassador came, America bombed them. Black people always get fooled by peace.

“He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”: Christ, the King of kings and Lord of lords. “But he shall be broken without hand”, without man’s hands. “For it shall be for many days”: centuries from Daniel until now.

Christians talk about the Antichrist coming as if it were one man, like Trump. “Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.”

It is not one antichrist but many, just as the wicked counsellor is a system. When people say Christ was a Caucasian, that is antichrist: they reject the Christ with skin like it burned in a furnace and want the blond-haired, blue-eyed leprosy Jesus. The Christ that keeps no commandments is antichrist.

God made a promise to end this affliction. “Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom”. Edom is the so-called white man and white woman, the pure-blooded Caucasian Europeans. “The cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked”: naked with sin.

“The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion”: the twelve tribes of Israel. “He will no more carry thee away into captivity”: no more slave ships to serve slavery in another country. That is “I will afflict thee no more.”

“He will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.” Now God is going to visit Edom for what they have done.

What does it mean that no more of their name be sown? Of Babylon: “Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people”, with missiles and bombs; they don’t even care about their own people, as COVID-19 showed. “The seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.” Seed is semen, which is lineage.

“Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities. For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew”. He is going to wipe them out. That is the name no more sown in Nahum 1:14.

The seed of evildoers is a lineage: “In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.”

The white man has never done righteousness, and he has never loved Jacob, his brother. Those are the children of the devil, the seed of evildoers of Isaiah 14:20, and our people make alliances and allegiance with them to do the same thing.

“For thou art vile.” God said the same of Antiochus Epiphanes: “And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.” That is what Antiochus did.

The commentaries call Antiochus a precursor to the Antichrist in the last days, and some scholars know that what is written of him is really speaking of America in the last days. Nineveh is vile, Antiochus was vile, and America is vile.

Why does Nahum name Judah? “The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.”

In Numbers 2, in the formation of Israel’s camp, Judah was put in the front, and there is a reason. God saves Judah first, so that the other tribes do not magnify themselves against Judah.

Once Judah is raised up, what does Judah do? “And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah”, because Judah would be teaching, “and bring him unto his people”. Judah would identify Benjamin, Levi, Ephraim, Manasseh, Reuben, Gad, Issachar and Naphtali. That was Judah’s lot, and it has been done today.

“Let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.” God is going to help Judah against all his enemies, and we have a lot of enemies.

Here is the precept to the feet on the mountains in Nahum 1:15. “How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?” A preacher is a modern word for a prophet. “And how shall they preach, except they be sent?”

That is why the men should get their passports, so they can be sent to teach brothers and sisters who have never heard this truth. It is shadowbanned on YouTube and blocked in country after country, so we must go out and teach.

“How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!” “But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?” The report is the scriptures. “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.” To increase our faith we must constantly hear what the word of God is saying.

sense.text:
“Woe to the bloody city!” In case you say this cannot be America, only Nineveh: was America built on blood? It is a bloody kingdom, built on the blood of the tribes of Gad, Reuben and Issachar, slaughtered, and then they built churches and courthouses on the blood and bones of our ancestors to judge people and teach them about Jesus.

“It is all full of lies and robbery”. Everything they have they robbed and stole, and they lie about everything. Lie number one, Jesus is white. Lie number two, it doesn’t matter what he looked like. Lie number three, y’all are not the children of Israel, y’all are Gentiles. “The prey departeth not”.

“The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.” That gives a time era, like 1776. “And there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses”: so many dead in ancient Assyria and in this kingdom. Millions of Native American Indians were killed here: the tribe of Gad, the so-called Mexicans, and the tribe of Reuben, slaughtered.

“Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot”: America is the wellfavoured harlot, “the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” Were we sold into slavery? How can you read this and say America didn’t do it? That is us they sold, and our families.

“Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.” God is against them. Though Nahum writes about Nineveh, it is reflective of Babylon: Isaiah 47 says the same exact thing of Babylon. Babylon and Assyria today are America.

“And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.” God will make America vile and set her before the nations to be gazed upon, as Isaiah says of Babylon.

“And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?” Who is going to cry for Nineveh?

precepts.why:
The mistress of witchcrafts: “Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth”. Their youth is 1776. America is the youngest kingdom on earth, 249 years old, its 250th anniversary next year. From their youth they laid Masonic and Illuminati symbols throughout Washington DC; the streets around the Capitol form the goat head. And you say this is such a God-fearing country.

“Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels”: their councils, their Congress, their cabinet, the House of Representatives. “Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.” The words differ, but the spirit behind them is the same.

Destruction is coming here, and God is mocking Babylon, the wellfavoured harlot: do your witchcraft, let’s see it work, let’s see it stop the prophecies I said would happen.

Revelation shows the same thing: an angel “cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.”

“Standing afar off for the fear of her torment”: the torment God mocked them about in Isaiah 47. “Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” It is going to take God one hour to destroy this place.

“And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her”: the merchants are the corporations of the earth, “for no man buyeth their merchandise any more”. The merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, and on to “horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.” How are you going to tell me that is not America? You want to tell me America didn’t sell us as slaves? That is what selleth nations means.

Read to the end of the chapter: “And the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee”: no more marriages here. “For thy merchants were the great men of the earth”, the corporations; “for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.” That is the witchcraft of Nahum 3:4.

Nahum’s discovering of the skirts is said the same way of Babylon. “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne”: your throne is done, your kingdom finished. “For thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate”: you will no more be called Christian, for that is what they say they are, tender and delicate.

“Uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.” A woman in holiness covers her head and wears a long dress down to the ankles. America portrays herself as a righteous woman, and God says uncover your locks, raise it up. “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen”: you are not a virgin. A virgin, when she uncovers herself, everything is tight and closed; this one is flapping in the wind, them lips is everywhere.

“I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.”

Who is the virgin daughter of Babylon ethnically? “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. O daughter of Babylon”.

Edom is called the daughter of Babylon. Ancient Babylon were the Cushites, Hamites, pure-blooded Africans. This Babylon is Edom, the white man, the one Isaiah 47 tells to come down and sit in the dust.

Of Babylon, set as a gazingstock: “They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”.

America makes the earth tremble and shakes kingdoms through war. They drop bombs on countries, and when they are not dropping them they give them to fake Israel to drop on Palestine, the West Bank, Jordan, Yemen and Qatar.

In Isaiah 14 God calls Babylon Lucifer, and here it says “Is this the man”. Babylon, Lucifer, is man on earth: the white man.

Who will bemoan Nineveh? “And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning”. To bewail is to moan, cry, weep and lament.

“Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” Revelation says the same thing as Nahum.

sense.text: “O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.” God scattered us in slavery.
“Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.” David is saying heal us, Lord, heal the brokenness within us.

“Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.” Moses told us that if we broke the commandments we would go into slavery and be oppressed. We said no; now we have seen it, we have lived it, and we are in it.

“Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth.” That goes back to the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace. Verse 1 says we are scattered; here God gives a banner for the gathering of the twelve tribes, “That thy beloved may be delivered”: the twelve tribes delivered. “Save with thy right hand, and hear me.”
“I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.” That is the separation of kingdoms and nations.

“Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver”. Why Judah the lawgiver, when Levi gave the law? Because the lawgiver is Christ, who sprang out of Judah.

“Moab is my washpot”. Moab is China; they always have the laundromats, and they made a laundry commercial mocking us, washing the black off. In the kingdom they are going to wash whatever we tell them to wash. “Over Edom will I cast out my shoe”: throwing a shoe is a sign of disrespect, as when a journalist threw a shoe at George Bush. It is get out of my house, the way you throw a shoe at a dog. That is what God is going to do to the white man. “Philistia, triumph thou because of me.”

“Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?” Jehovah’s Witnesses teach that Edom is done away with, that King Saul killed all of Edom. That is a lie; the prophecy asks who will lead God into Edom. Edom would be the strongest city, the strongest kingdom on earth: the strong city of Edom is Babylon the great.

“Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?” We prayed, you didn’t go out with our armies before; we lost the battle and went into slavery.
“Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.” That is the prayer of Judah, hear, Lord, the voice of Judah. Vain is the help of man: you can’t get help from the Arabs or from Russia.
“Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.” Brothers, through God we shall do valiantly.

precepts.why: God scattered us, and “He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.” That is what you are seeing now: he is gathering us again.

The same precept: “When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered”. We are scattered among the nations. “Then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.”

In the New Testament: “James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.” We were scattered; that is what slavery was all about, scattering our race, our kingdom and our people.

The banner: “Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain”. The banner is the Bible, and the high mountain is the highest government in the world, Babylon. “Exalt the voice unto them”: don’t sound like a simp or a squirrel. “Shake the hand”: when you shake the hand you are rebuking and correcting, “that they may go into the gates of the nobles.”

That is the gathering of the twelve tribes: Judah, Benjamin, Levi, Ephraim, Manasseh, Simeon, Zebulun, Gad, Reuben, Asher, Issachar and Naphtali, assembled for war.

Everybody thinks God wants everybody together. “When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.” The twelve tribes got the best land and all the other nations were set around us.

Christianity wants to bring all races together because it comes from ancient Babylon: the Tower of Babel was bringing everybody together against God, and it is the same today. All nations are not supposed to be together; they are supposed to be separated. That was God’s plan. The white man calls that racist while he builds weapons to go into space to fight against God.
“For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; he will save us.” The Lord who is our lawgiver is Christ.

“For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.” The new priesthood was Judah. Judah is the lawgiver because Christ, the Lord, came out of Judah. He is the lawgiver.

What does “Philistia, triumph thou because of me” mean? Psalm 108 says it plainly: “Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.” God will triumph over Philistia, which is Palestine; we are going to triumph over Philistia.

Who will lead God into Edom? “Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah?” Bozrah is the capital of Edom. “I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save”: that is Christ.

“Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?” Isaiah asks why there is red all over his clothes, as if he had been stomping grapes. “I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me”: I don’t need the Israelites to help me. “For I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.” He will tread Edom in his anger.

So the Son of God knows exactly who he is coming back to fight. Edom is not done away with.

“For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea”. Christ’s sword comes down on Idumea. Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. When Christians say Edom was done away with thousands of years ago, that is a lie.

“But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.” When we fought Edom in the dark ages and the Renaissance, God did not go out with our armies, and we had armies. Images of black men in Europe show us as knights, St. Maurice among them, in castles with bows and arrows, swords and lances. We were not just running naked through Africa with bones in our noses like the Tarzan movies; we were more than that.

“Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.” We ran from our enemies, and the white man defeated us, robbed us, beat us and destroyed us, because God did not go forth with us.

Through God we shall do valiantly, but to do valiantly we must return to what the Bible says we are and what it says we must do. “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope”: the stronghold is God’s laws, his word. “Even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee”.

“When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim”: he raises Judah first and uses Judah and Ephraim like weapons of war, “and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece”. You never read that in church. We will be raised up against the white man, not today but when the Lord returns, “and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.” That is the valiantly of Psalm 60:12.

“And the Lord shall be seen over them”: that is how you know it is not right now; we are not ready. “The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine”, as if we were drunk, partying.

“And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.” Each man and woman like the rubies in a crown, lifted up and delivered from destruction, and all the world will see the twelve tribes of Israel. “For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty!”

“And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the Lord”: we are going to be everywhere, “as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men”, because God is our king.

“And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep”: not an old lion but a young lion. What can sheep do to a lion? Nothing but be food. “Who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.” We are going to tread down the nations and tear them in pieces.

“Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.” All of them. That is God treading down our enemies.
